dialogues.speaker: NPC#17217
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...What am I supposed to do? The snowstorm is getting so fierce... Why aren't they back yet? But... But I'm only here to bring them hot tea. Ah, what am I supposed to do?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why are you making gestures at the mountain like that? Oh, Paimon gets it. Are you... praying to the mountain?

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17217
dialogues.text: *sigh* You could say that. Three of my friends went hunting in the mountains, and I'm in charge of looking after the camp.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17217
dialogues.text: I also brew some hot tea to warm them up, things like that... I don't know a thing about hunting, so that's all I can do. But they still haven't come back, and I'm a little worried...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17217
dialogues.text: Oh, please, snowy mountain, I beg you. Bring my friends back, or they'll freeze solid out there.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17217
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...Or perhaps you two could help me bring this hot tea to my friends?

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17217
dialogues.text: Seeing how you walk through the cold wind without your steps faltering at all, you must be quite used to harsh conditions like these.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17217
dialogues.text: The tea is right here. If you could get it to them before it goes cold...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we could do that?

choices.text: Alright, let's give it a try!

response.speaker: NPC#17217
response.text: I'm counting on you. Ah, and if you can't find them, or if the tea goes cold, you can come back and get more!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lukov, Lukov... Is everything alright? Are they okay?

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17217
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you! You're back!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17217
dialogues.text: They're all right, at least for now... But before you brought that hot tea up to them, things weren't looking good. They almost couldn't make it back down the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17217
dialogues.text: I was right to ask you for help. *sigh*... Otherwise, I might have lost all three of my friends at once.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17217
dialogues.text: Here's your reward... People who step up to help others deserve a little extra. Haha, that way, more people will be willing to do the same.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Your friend asked us to bring you this hot tea!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17218
dialogues.text: Oh, thank you so much. Ah... This is wonderful. Just holding it makes me feel warmer... I almost couldn't make it back down. It's far too cold out here...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17218
dialogues.text: My friends and I got separated in the snowstorm, too. If you hadn't brought me this bowl of hot tea, I might not have made it back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, then you should drink that tea and head back right away!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17218
dialogues.text: Y—Yes...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The hunter named Malkin drinks the hot tea.\nThen he heads down the mountain while warmth still lingers in his body.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17217
dialogues.text: On a day this cold, it'd be great to have a bowl of hot tea to warm the body... *sigh* If only someone could help deliver it.

choices.text: Alright, let me give it a try!

response.speaker: NPC#17217
response.text: I’ll leave it to you, then. Ah, and if you can't find them, or if the tea goes cold, you can come back and get more!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How are you feeling? Are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17220
dialogues.text: Uh... I-I'm fine, just a little cold... *sigh* If only I had a bowl of hot tea to drink. Ugh... If we don't make it back, Lukov's gonna be worried sick.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17220
dialogues.text: Talking about hot tea makes me think of him. The tea he brews always has this nice, delicate fragrance...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We had a feeling this is what you're talking about.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17220
dialogues.text: Oh... Yes, that's the flavor. Did he ask you to come find me?

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17220
dialogues.text: Ugh... I really thought I was done for. Thank you, and thank Lukov's tea, too... *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don’t cry! If you cry out here, your tears and snot will freeze right onto your face... You need to get back to camp first!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17220
dialogues.text: You're right. I need to get down the mountain first...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The hunter named Nalkin drinks the hot tea.\nThen he heads down the mountain while warmth still lingers in his body.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How are you feeling? Are you all right?

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17219
dialogues.text: Ah, I remember... Just before I passed out, I saw a bear... Thank you. If you two hadn't come to my aid, the beasts would have torn me apart...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17219
dialogues.text: If I'd been a little warmer, I might not have ended up like this. Ugh... Come to think of it, isn't this the hot tea Lukov brewed...?

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17219
dialogues.text: Did Lukov ask you to come looking for me? That's very nice of him...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17219
dialogues.text: Then I'll have to thank him once I get back down the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17219
dialogues.text: My friends and I got separated in the snowstorm, too. I wonder how they're doing... *sigh* Well, I can barely look after myself right now, so this isn't the time to worry about them.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17219
dialogues.text: Thank you, you two! I'll never forget that you saved my life!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The hunter named Morov drinks the hot tea.\nThen he heads down the mountain while warmth still lingers in his body.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17217
dialogues.text: Did you get it to them...? There are three of them in total. Or did the tea go cold? If it did, you can take more from here. You can leave the cold tea here as well, and I'll heat it up again.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17218
dialogues.text: Whew... Let me... Let me rest for a moment.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17218
dialogues.text: It's so warm here in camp. *sigh*...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17220
dialogues.text: Thank you! Thank you both for your help...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17220
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Without you two, I really wouldn't have made it down the mountain. *sigh*...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17219
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Now that I've come back to my senses, it still scares me when I think back. Next time we go hunting...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17219
dialogues.text: Next time, we’' better make sure we're prepared before going hunting in the snowy mountains.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17217
dialogues.text: Hmm... Another pot of tea is ready. I have to say, hot tea really does taste good out here in all this snow...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#17217
dialogues.text: It would taste even better if I don't have friends who insist on going up the mountain to hunt, then nearly get themselves stranded up there!
